notes.title: Patch Notes 1.09 - Custom keyboard controls, better weapon hitboxes, etc.
notes.content:
Mortal Manor 1.09 is live! I'll continue to address any issues users have as well as fine tune the game as much as possible. Thanks for your interest!

Patch Notes 1.09 - Mar 4, 2018
- Fixed full screen selecting bug.
- Set new hitboxes for spears.
- Set new hitboxes for overhead weapons.
- Set new hitboxes for fist weapons.
- Changed any projectile weapon abilities from pressing left->right to holding up or quarter circle down-left or right to activate.
- Fixed various misc hitbox issues. 
- Easier to hit with overhead swing and spear weapons, but they do less damage now.
- Some weapons have a faster or slower swing.
- Fixed enemy hp bar display issue when playing on easy or hard mode.
- Weapon abilities grow in strength with weapons.
- Removed invisible platform.
- Game starts on "Continue" if save file is present.
- Added difficulty level descriptions.
- Fixed exp bar display issue when loading.
- Added Steam Screenshot support.
- Save option settings within inventory.
- Save controls within inventory.
- Added stat and option descriptions in inventory.
- Added death counter.
- Fixed inventory layout.
- Fixed save file layout.
- Fixed item drop formula. Drops are more likely with lower luck than before.
- Rebalanced Exp gains from enemies.
- Stat Items increase by 6 and 12 instead of 25% and 50%.
- Fixed some room transition layouts.
- Balanced exp gains from items in ?????? mode.
- Added keyboard control customization.
- Keys 1-6 bring up different menu pages.

In Progress: Fixing map issues, odd graphics for uppercut.
